rationale.diversity: Use a 40% project-share ceiling plus >=20 distinct projects rather than an arbitrary five-case cap; current corpus has 35 projects and largest share 37%.
rationale.reproduction: The original final tar omitted previously audited repository bundles and pub caches. This release therefore uses a truthful two-stage protocol: online materialization with exact hash/tree/lock verification, followed by OS-enforced offline test execution.
rationale.curation: The collection task explicitly uses LLM API review to replace manual curation; two independent review passes are retained and human review is not falsely claimed.
